title: Restriction with no fixed coordinates
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $z$ be an assignment on the empty coordinate set, and let $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The restriction of $f$ with no coordinates fixed, evaluated at the free-coordinate part of $x$, equals $f(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
